_comment: Soul larva, aged state. Per project_soul_larvae_cosmology: judged soul that has been stalled at Acheron shore long enough for the unfired imprint to have begun discharging inward, hollowing the soul out. Hostile -- aggression is the imprint seeking outlet on any moving substrate. Lunges at the Vagrant on sight, dies in 1-2 hits, drops more sangue than fresh. Visual differentiation: sangue-darkened texture, more deformed mesh (TBD), lurching run+bite clips. Mesh + rig shared with X_Bot per universal-humanoid-enemy-rule. Every clip family explicitly overridden to a zombie clip; silent fallback to X_Bot defaults would surface X_Bot humanoid combat clips during Combat states.
_comment_run_register: Aged larvae have been infused by sangue + inward-imprint firing long enough to stand and charge. ALL movement registers as zombie_run -- no walking, no creeping. The feral aggression is the cosmology made motion; a creeping aged larva would dilute that. Strafe + back + walk all map to zombie_run; the BT's slow-pace strafing reads as a feral sideways run, which is acceptable for v1.
_comment_physical_reactions: Flinch + hit_react clips left at humanoid defaults (X_Bot flinch_*, hit_react_*). These are physical reactions to external force, not expressions of contrapasso state -- a sword hit causes a sword-hit reaction regardless of which contrapasso-shaped soul receives it. Overriding to zombie_scream made the larva scream on every hit, which read as fatigued rather than menacing.
_comment_aggro: zombie_scream fires once on Suspicious -> Alerted (Souls Hollow-wake convention). Movement-locked for full duration; chase begins after. Cosmologically: the inward-firing imprint finds outlet at the moment of sighting.
_comment_sangue_drop: Aged larvae have absorbed more inward-firing imprint than fresh; killing them releases slightly more sangue. Still small-scale -- playable amounts arrive at keeper-fall events, not trash kills. Trash baseline locked at order-of-magnitude single-digit per kill.
_comment_tint_color: Sangue-darkened deep red -- the aged larva's substance has been saturated by centuries of inward-firing imprint. larva_fresh.tint_burn_target_archetype points here, so the fresh-to-aged burn-lerp ends on this exact color (smooth transition at the moment of conversion).
_comment_avoids_hazards: Damned souls dissolve on contact with Acheron's sangue-flow (river-dissolves-on-contact per setting.md substance law + soul-larvae cosmology). The BT chase leaf skips when target is in the river; locomotion velocity clamps at the boundary. Player in the river is effectively unreachable -- the queue stays at the bank, eternally awaiting.

actions._comment: Aged larva right-hand swipe using zombie_attack. The clip is a right-handed swinging strike (NOT a bite); hitbox_joint = RightHand so the hitbox spawns on the joint that visibly extends forward during the active window AND the reach computation measures the correct joint trajectory. Reach is clip-derived; see for the system and for the joint-choice rule.
actions._comment_timing: Visible strike peak at clip-time ~1.05s per direct preview observation. windup=0.90 + active=0.30 brackets clip-time [0.90, 1.20], comfortably covering the visible contact. Clip plays at authored cadence. effective_reach_override=0.8 caps the BT chase-stop at 0.8m.
